titre: Malicious attack — what happened and how we responded to strengthen the security of our tools
resume_p1: Between June 23 and July 7, 2026, our website and voting application were subjected to a malicious attack.
resume_p2: Our team responded quickly to protect data confidentiality, bring our tools back online, strengthen their security, and protect our infrastructure.
resume_p3: If you have had no interaction with the association and have not organized a vote on the application, none of your personal data is affected.
resume_donnees_titre: Only the following data is affected:
resume_donnees_1: Information concerning a few members of the association's board of directors
resume_donnees_2: the content of our association's email accounts
resume_donnees_3: data from elections created on the application (excluding email addresses, as the current version of the application does not store them)
contact_p: Our team remains fully available to answer any questions.
detail_p1: An unauthorized third party gained access to the association's hosting account, which allowed them to temporarily take our application offline and access our association's email accounts.
detail_donnees_titre: The data affected is as follows:
detail_donnees_1: Information relating to a few members of the association's board of directors
detail_donnees_2: the content of our association's email accounts
detail_donnees_3: Data from elections created on the application (excluding emails, as the current version of the application does not store them)
verif_titre: We were able to verify the following points:
verif_1: The application's email sending tool recorded no connections during the period of the attack
verif_2: The CRM recording information from the mieuxvoter.fr website forms recorded no connections during this period
suite_titre: Following the discovery of the incident, we have:
suite_1: Regained control of our access and secured our entire infrastructure
suite_2: Filed a complaint with the authorities
suite_3: Notified the CNIL in accordance with GDPR
suite_4: Strengthened our security measures to prevent such a situation from happening again
app_ok: The application is now working normally again.
savoir_p1: The Mieux Voter application, in its current version, does not collect identifying personal data about its users — no account, no password, no recorded IP address. Votes are anonymous, so no personal data related to organizing a vote could have been stolen, other than the title and the options put to a vote.

excuses_p: We apologize for this situation and remain available for any questions.
